title.narrative: Balochistan Water Security and Productivity Improvement Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve flood protection, increase access to water for productive use, and improve water supply service delivery in selected areas of Balochistan
The Project includes three components Component A – Flood and watershed management strengtheningComponent B – QWASA service delivery strengtheningComponent C – Contingent Emergency Response
